title: California officials discover mass graves of dog bodies at 'no-kill' sanctuary
summary: A northern California animal rescue sanctuary, Miranda's Rescue, has been found to have 117 dead dogs with evidence of gunshots. Police are investigating the cause of the deaths and have also discovered over 600 missing dog collars on the premises.
summary_points: Police uncovered 117 dead dogs at a 'no-kill' shelter in northern California
Many canine remains showed signs of gunshots, sparking an investigation into animal killings
Over 600 dog collars were found on the premises, where investigators suspect animals were killed
The cause of the deaths is still unknown and police are continuing to investigate
Hundreds more animals are still missing from the California facility
